tagline: Simple stereo reverb with size, damping and width
description: A stereo reverb built on JUCE's standard reverb (a Freeverb-style comb and all-pass network), not a model of a plate. Use it for general-purpose room and space on a send or insert.

features.name: Size
features.description: Sets the room size, and with it the decay length.

features.name: Damping
features.description: Sets how quickly high frequencies fade in the tail.

features.name: Width
features.description: Sets the stereo spread of the reverb from mono to full width.

features.name: Mix
features.description: Crossfades from the dry signal at 0 to the reverb alone at 1, scaled so each end keeps its nominal level.
